summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. New file rdflib/extras/shacl.py provides parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier) and SHACLPathError (direct Exception subclass). New tests in test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py: one parametrized test for valid and invalid shapes (also checks graph triples are unchanged), plus a test for None and plain-string inputs. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass (41 tests). Not verified: mypy, ruff, and black are not installed in the shared venv, so the type-check gate and formatting were checked by reading the code and by a line-length check only (no lines over 88). Nothing was committed, and no core modules, __init__ files, or dependencies were changed.
